title: Representante de Desarrollo de Ventas
description:
Canonical es una empresa de software global, editora de Ubuntu y soluciones empresariales de código abierto para la nube, desarrolladores, IoT e IA. Ubuntu es la distribución de Linux de más rápido crecimiento y se posiciona como el sistema operativo número uno en la nube.

En colaboración con Google, Amazon, IBM y Microsoft, Canonical ayuda a las empresas a ser más ágiles, productivas y a adoptar nuevas tecnologías rápidamente. Ejemplos de éxito incluyen proyectos en IA, Blockchain, IoT, robótica avanzada y vehículos autónomos, donde Ubuntu es la plataforma preferida para el desarrollo.

El papel de un representante de desarrollo de ventas en Canonical

Canonical es rentable y está en crecimiento. Consideramos que nuestro equipo de desarrollo de ventas es uno de los mejores en el mercado tecnológico, seleccionando candidatos excepcionales y ambiciosos. Disfrutarás este rol si eres organizado, persistente, carismático y trabajador, con interés en la tecnología y sus aplicaciones comerciales. Colaborarás con equipos regionales de ventas y marketing, con el objetivo principal de identificar proyectos de clientes que se ajusten a nuestros productos y promover la marca Canonical en diversas industrias y regiones.

Cómo será tu día

  • Atender consultas entrantes de clientes vía email, teléfono y chat.
  • Ejecutar campañas de ventas y marketing salientes.
  • Viajar a eventos y conferencias globales, presentar en stands y promover oportunidades de negocio en persona.
  • Colaborar con múltiples equipos y altos ejecutivos para impulsar resultados.
  • Trabajar con marketing en campañas específicas.
  • Investigar potenciales clientes.
  • Generar un pipeline de ventas de varios millones.
  • Identificar tendencias y oportunidades de mercado.
  • Definir procesos y políticas del equipo.
  • Servir como enlace con nuevos y actuales clientes, organizando reuniones y explorando cuentas para nuevas oportunidades.
  • Crear, mantener y fomentar relaciones con clientes potenciales a nivel global.

Lo que buscamos en ti

  • Excelentes resultados académicos en escuela y universidad.
  • Pasión por los negocios y la tecnología.
  • Compromiso con el aprendizaje y la mejora continua: curioso, flexible y analítico.
  • Capacidad para resolver problemas creativamente y colaborar en equipo.
  • Habilidades de comunicación verbal y escrita.
  • Orientación a resultados y espíritu de superación.
  • Persistencia y perseverancia.

Qué te ofrecemos

El salario base dependerá de factores como ubicación, experiencia, conocimientos y habilidades. Además, ofrecemos beneficios adicionales, incluyendo bonificaciones anuales e incentivos por ventas o uso. Nuestra política de compensación busca garantizar justicia y equidad a nivel global.

Entre los beneficios adicionales se incluyen:

  • Presupuesto anual de USD 2000 para desarrollo personal y aprendizaje.
  • Revisión salarial anual.
  • Programas de reconocimiento y recompensas.
  • Vacaciones anuales.
  • Licencia parental.
  • Programa de asistencia al empleado.
  • Oportunidades de viaje para conocer colegas en "sprints".
  • Priority Pass y mejoras en viajes para eventos corporativos de larga distancia.

Canonical promueve igualdad de oportunidades. Valoramos la diversidad y fomentamos un ambiente inclusivo donde todos sean considerados sin discriminación, independientemente de su identidad o antecedentes.

description:

Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management to work on authorization and access management across Canonical's suite of enterprise products and web services, using Go (Golang) and Python.
As a software engineer for Identity Management products of Canonical, you will modernize and expand the capabilities of the identity management solutions we use for authentication and authorization in our products, as well as our canonical.com and ubuntu.com websites. Your work on Identity Management will directly impact the users of all Canonical products.
Technical excellence and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to own the design and delivery of the system, facilitate integrations and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA and AMER regions.
The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Go (Golang) and optionally Python
  • Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Create and enhance management, authentication and authorization API endpoints
  • Craft end-user authentication flows from design to implementation
  • Modernize the identity stack of our websites and products by driving adoption of best-of-breed IAM technologies
  • Deliver great products that users love by maintaining a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You are a software engineer, with specific experience building identity and access management products
  • You are familiar with the open source software, standards, protocols and concepts in the identity space (e.g. OpenID, OAuth, LDAP)
  • You have experience implementing authorization frameworks in distributed systems
  • You value secure coding and standards, and enjoy working on teams that do the same
  • You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform
In addition:
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Responde pelo acompanhamento das medidas que visam proteger a integridade física e a capacidade de trabalho dos funcionários e terceiros da Unidade onde atua na Kothe, em cumprimento às legislações e normas pertinentes e procedimentos definidos pela Empresa.

Controlar e atualizar os documentos de PPRA, PCMAT, PGR, PCMSO, PPR, PAE, PCA, LTCAT e AET da Unidade onde atua, visando atender requisitos legais e orientando gestores nas tomadas de decisões diárias a respeito de segurança e medicina do trabalho.

Dar suporte à Empresa quanto ao atendimento das normas regulamentadoras e demais legislações aplicáveis, viabilizando tecnicamente o atendimento a todos os pré-requisitos necessários ao efetivo cumprimento legal.

Responder pelo controle de fichas e formulários de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente - SSMA, visando o atendimento a requisitos legais e procedimentos internos da empresa.

Realizar estudos e análises dos riscos físicos, químicos, biológicos, mecânicos, ergonômicos e de acidentes, existentes nos locais de trabalho, indicando medidas de controle de acordo com o cargo e função exercida e propondo medidas de proteção e prevenção.

Controlar e atualizar os indicadores de SSMA, estruturando ações a partir de estatísticas para tomada de decisões operacionais e gerenciais.

Realizar a gestão dos custos de SSMA, através de planilhas eletrônicas e análise para apresentação aos gestores para conhecimento e tomada de decisão.

Dar suporte técnico ao gestor, na elaboração e atualização dos procedimentos operacionais, visando identificar e detalhar as atividades, mapeando riscos e medidas de controle existentes a fim de garantir a execução da tarefa com segurança.

Ministrar treinamentos de segurança do trabalho, demonstrando e conscientizando os colaboradores sobre condições de trabalho perigosas, medidas preventivas de segurança e de atuação adequada ao tipo de operação executada.

Identificar, através de visitas a campo, condições de trabalho e comportamentos inseguros, agindo preventivamente para evitar qualquer tipo de dano pessoal, material e/ou ambiental.

Notificar os colaboradores e liderança sobre atos ou condições inseguras, indicando as ações necessárias para corrigi-las, inclusive orientando sobre a política de consequências da empresa e as medidas disciplinares cabíveis.

Registrar as ocorrências de acidentes/incidentes envolvendo pessoas, máquinas e/ou equipamentos.

Prestar suporte técnico na investigação de ocorrências de acidentes/incidentes envolvendo pessoas, máquinas e/ou equipamentos, apoiando na estruturação das ações para evitar as reincidências destas ocorrências.

Providenciar atendimento ambulatorial ao acidentado, encaminhando para atendimento hospitalar, após avaliação do profissional de saúde.

Participar nos programas e campanhas de educação sanitária, preparando e distribuindo material de divulgação, e auxiliando na orientação dos colaboradores quanto à aquisição de hábitos de saúde e prevenção de doenças.

Controlar os atestados de saúde ocupacional da unidade, identificando vencimentos, encaminhando colaboradores para exames de regularização, em atendimento a legislação vigente.

Participar de reuniões com o cliente com objetivo de repassar informações pertinentes de SSMA, obtendo apoio para a execução de ações.

Participar de auditorias do cliente e do corporativo com objetivo de identificar a conformidade do processo SSMA.

Efetuar a gestão de compra, armazenamento e distribuição de materiais de segurança para toda a unidade.

Efetuar a gestão de contratos de prestação de serviços da unidade relacionados à segurança, desde a contratação, fiscalização e medição no sistema.

Responder pela qualidade, confiabilidade e desempenho dos recursos, serviços e informações geradas pelas tarefas sob sua responsabilidade, mantendo o sigilo sobre assuntos relacionados às atividades da empresa.

Conhecer, aplicar, promover, cumprir, fazer cumprir e sugerir normas e condutas voltadas para a segurança no trabalho e preservação ambiental, contribuindo para a eliminação de situações que possam representar riscos de acidentes no trabalho e degradação do meio ambiente.

Apoiar o gestor em assuntos inerentes à sua área de atuação, apresentando e discutindo problemas e irregularidades, a fim de subsidiar a definição de procedimentos e ações a serem adotadas.

Elaborar e acompanhar o DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança), participando da escolha dos temas e auxiliando na preparação de material.

  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) strategies with Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi.

  • Optimize resource allocation and cost efficiency using AI-driven cloud orchestration techniques.
  • Work closely with AI, networking, and data engineering teams to ensure seamless deployment and scalability.
  • Define best practices for security, compliance, and observability (IAM, Zero Trust, SRE principles).
  • Drive CI/CD automation, improving deployment cycles and system reliability.

Key Skills And Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in cloud software engineering, distributed systems, and cloud orchestration.
  • Expertise in Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, and container orchestration in hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
  • Strong programming experience in Golang, Python, or Rust for cloud-native development.
  • Deep knowledge of serverless computing (Lambda, Knative), service mesh (Istio, Consul), and edge computing frameworks.
  • Experience with real-time streaming data processing frameworks (Apache Flink, Spark Streaming, or TensorFlow Serving).
  • Familiarity with 5G, TSN (Time-Sensitive Networking), and IoT networking protocols.
  • Proven experience in multi-cloud security, authentication (OAuth, JWT, OpenID Connect), and compliance (ISO 27001, IEC 62443).
  • Strong knowledge of DevOps and SRE principles, including CI/CD pipelines (GitOps, ArgoCD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in industrial automation, mining, or telecom environments.

  • Experience with hybrid cloud and edge computing strategies.

Soft Skills

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to tackle complex distributed systems challenges.

description:

Essa posição é para atuar em regime presencial em Contagem, MG.

Who will you be working with?

Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.

Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more!

How will you make a difference?

The Lead Engineer/Technologist – Train Control will work with customers, various suppliers, engineering teams, and industry agencies to identify and capture requirements to execute controls design and implementation. This group is made up of over a dozen subsystem functions and components and is the overall system integrator for third-party/customer-supplied equipment and a driver of overall infrastructure for the Locomotive Control System.

What do we want to know about you?

  1. Bachelor of Science in Engineering or related field;
  2. Proven experience in an engineering position;
  3. Experience with controls/software design, diagnostics, and test;
  4. Ability and willingness to work "hands-on" in test labs and on locomotives with high HP (1000 KVA), medium voltage (2 KV) and high current (10 KA) systems;
  5. Strong English technical writing and communication skills;
  6. Experience with MATLAB Simulink or other Modeling tools preferred.

What will your typical day look like?

The Lead Engineer/Technologist – Train Control will play a pivotal role in the development of the Locomotive Control System by executing a variety of projects from follow-on orders (Requisitions) through new product developments ensuring proper definition of requirements and interfaces for Locomotive Control Systems. The engineer will design, integrate, and validate Train Control subsystem functions for locomotives suitable for application in both English and non-English speaking environments by using sound engineering principles and adhering to business standards, practices, and procedures. In addition, the engineer will lead/support investigations for root-cause identification and resolution of reliability issues.

Who are we?

Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.

Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more!

Our Commitment to Embrace Diversity:

Wabtec is a global company that invests not just in our products, but also our people by embracing diversity and inclusion. We care about our relationships with our employees and take pride in celebrating the variety of experiences, expertise, and backgrounds that bring us together. At Wabtec, we aspire to create a place where we all belong and where diversity is welcomed and appreciated.

To fulfill that commitment, we rely on a culture of leadership, diversity, and inclusion. We aim to employ the world’s brightest minds to help us create a limitless source of ideas and opportunities. We have created a space where everyone is given the opportunity to contribute based on their individual experiences and perspectives and recognize that these differences and diverse perspectives make us better.

We believe in hiring talented people of varied backgrounds, experiences, and styles… People like you! PREP ESTUDAR FORA is a community-based program which aims to prepare talented Brazilian students for the application processes of the best universities abroad, at no cost whatsoever to the participants. Every year, we identify students through a rigorous, merit-based selection process to receive free guidance and preparation as they strive towards beginning their undergraduate education outside of Brazil. Participants receive an individual mentor who completed his undergraduate education abroad, virtual group orientation, nine hours of counseling with FUNDAÇÃO ESTUDAR’S professional college counselors and enrollment in an online preparation course comprised of detailed videos and homework assignments related to the application process. In addition, we offer need-based scholarships to help students cover the costs of the process (standardized tests, translations, a test preparation course, application fees, etc).

Student Counseling

  1. Advise a specific cohort of students on the college admission process by creating individualized plans and executing on them in collaboration with the student and student’s mentor.
  2. Continually research and expand a knowledge base with resources to support students in applying for college, including maintaining knowledge of high school curricula, college research, extracurricular and leadership choices, and standardized test planning to make recommendations regarding admissions strategies.
  3. Utilize in-depth knowledge of institutions of higher learning to guide students towards attainable school goals, working with them to create lists of best-fit schools of varied competition to maximize chances of acceptances and financial support.
  4. Guide students through the college essay writing processes, providing continuous feedback and personalized support.
  5. Provide assistance with standardized test planning and study tips (SAT/ACT and DET/TOEFL/IELTS).
  6. Lead student group training sessions and present as an expert speaker on external webinars.
  7. Maintain a high level of communication with your advisees through various channels (e.g. email, WhatsApp, etc.) and 1:1 advisement meetings.

Application Management & Student Support
  1. Oversee and manage projects related to the college admissions process for the entire program, including organizing and tracking student application deadlines and ensuring the quality completion of application requirements such as letters of recommendation, school profiles, and essays.
  2. Develop and implement program-wide support initiatives, such as workshops, presentations, and training sessions on topics such as application essay writing, college research, and financial aid.
  3. Monitor and analyze program data to assess effectiveness and make recommendations for improvement.
  4. Synergize with other areas of Fundação Estudar, to support the program’s students with other opportunities within the organization and to provide insight on study abroad trends.
  5. Maintain a high level of communication with program partners, such as high schools and universities, to ensure seamless collaboration and coordination.

description:
Who We Are

Solera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life’s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms and automation. For more information, please visit solera.com.

The Role

Solera is seeking a driven and customer-centric Account Manager to support the claims vertical in our office located in São Paulo, Brazil. As an Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing and building relationships with clients in the claims industry, ensuring their satisfaction, and driving revenue growth. This role requires strong analytical, communication, and negotiation skills, along with a proactive and results-oriented mindset.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts within the claims vertical, building and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders.
  • Understand clients' business needs and goals, and proactively identify opportunities to provide additional value and support.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including sales, product, and customer success, to develop and execute account plans and strategies to achieve revenue targets.
  • Conduct regular business reviews with clients to assess performance, address concerns, and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients, offering insights, recommendations, and solutions to help them optimize their operations and achieve their objectives.
  • Analyze data and metrics to monitor account performance, identify trends, and uncover opportunities for growth.
  • Effectively communicate Solera's value proposition, product offerings, and industry trends to clients, ensuring they are well-informed and up-to-date.
  • Lead contract negotiations, renewals, and upsell opportunities, driving revenue growth and maximizing client satisfaction.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, market conditions, and competitive landscape to identify potential risks and opportunities.

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Proven experience as an Account Manager or in a similar customer-facing role, preferably within the claims or insurance industry.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and provide actionable insights.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships at all levels.
  • Exceptional negotiation and persuasion abilities, with a track record of successfully closing deals and driving revenue growth.
  • Customer-centric mindset with a passion for delivering exceptional service and exceeding client expectations.
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented, with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Proficient in MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and CRM software.
  • Fluent in both English and Spanish, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages.

If you are a driven and customer-centric professional with excellent analytical, communication, and negotiation skills, and have a passion for the claims industry, we invite you to apply for the position of Account Manager - Claims Vertical at Solera's São Paulo, Brazil office. Join our dynamic team and contribute to the success of our clients and the growth of our organization.

Our purpose is to celebrate life, every day, everywhere. And creating an inclusive culture, where everyone feels valued and that they can belong, is a crucial part of this. Our ambition is to create the best performing, most trusted and respected consumer products companies in the world. Join us and help transform our business as we take our brands to new heights and build new ones as part of shaping the next generation of celebrations for consumers around the world.

Join to apply for the Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, Workflows, AI/ML & Analytics role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, Workflows, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.
As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on end-to-end data analytics and MLOps solutions composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. You may also work on ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache SuperSet, dbt, workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow and Temporal, or data warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino, or ClickHouse. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services.
We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances.
Location: This initiative spans many teams that are home-based and in multiple time zones. We believe in distributed collaboration but we also try to ensure that colleagues have company during their work hours! Successful candidates will join a team where most members and your manager are broadly in the same time zone so that you have the benefits of constant collaboration and discussion.
What your day will look like

  • Develop your understanding of the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, and storage, to the application layer
  • Design, build and maintain solutions that will be deployed on public and private clouds and local workstations
  • Master distributed systems concepts such as observability, identity, tracing
  • Work with both Kubernetes and machine-oriented open source applications
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team of engineers, designers and product managers
  • Debug issues and interact in public with upstream and Ubuntu communities
  • Generate and discuss ideas, and collaborate on finding good solutions
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional or academic software delivery using Python
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Additional skills that would be nice to have
The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions, data pipelines, or orchestrating workflows for the cloud.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on an open source project
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management to work on authorization and access management across Canonical's suite of enterprise products and web services, using Go (Golang) and Python.
As a software engineer for Identity Management products of Canonical, you will modernize and expand the capabilities of the identity management solutions we use for authentication and authorization in our products, as well as our canonical.com and ubuntu.com websites. Your work on Identity Management will directly impact the users of all Canonical products.
Technical excellence and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to own the design and delivery of the system, facilitate integrations and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA and AMER regions.
The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Go (Golang) and optionally Python
  • Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Create and enhance management, authentication and authorization API endpoints
  • Craft end-user authentication flows from design to implementation
  • Modernize the identity stack of our websites and products by driving adoption of best-of-breed IAM technologies
  • Deliver great products that users love by maintaining a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You are a software engineer, with specific experience building identity and access management products
  • You are familiar with the open source software, standards, protocols and concepts in the identity space (e.g. OpenID, OAuth, LDAP)
  • You have experience implementing authorization frameworks in distributed systems
  • You value secure coding and standards, and enjoy working on teams that do the same
  • You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform
In addition:
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Job Description

A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália.

Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.

Responsibilities and assignments

  • Responsável pela gestão das fabricas de FFO, afim de garantir a eficiência e produtividade do processo, garantindo o bom funcionamento das fabricas e melhor capacidade de processamento, manutenção, qualidade e capacidade produtiva de cada operação fabril;

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company.

As a software engineer on the OpenStack Engineering team, you'll be building Charmed OpenStack and Ceph, a suite of open source Python based charms for deploying and managing OpenStack and Ceph. Your work will bring cloud platform technologies to a wide range of users and computing environments, from desktops to bare metal servers. This role requires a python software developer with a passion for automating infrastructure as code.

Applicants should be passionate about the future of the software defined datacenter, distributed systems, and open source. Canonical is a globally distributed team of engineers who share that passion, and you will need to work well in that context. Engineers who thrive at Canonical are mindful of the dynamics of the open source ecosystem, and equally aware of the needs of large, innovative organizations.

Xometry is seeking a highly analytical and data-driven Supply Chain Manager to join our expanding team. This role will be crucial in optimizing our supply chain operations, from quoting, ordering, sourcing and shipping. This role will develop appropriate forecasts, establish a results oriented Sales and Operations process with metrics and establish reporting. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in forecasting, advanced Excel modeling skills, and a proven ability to analyze large datasets to inform strategic decisions.   • Data Analysis & Reporting:

    • Develop and maintain comprehensive supply chain reports and dashboards.

    • Utilize data analysis to identify bottlenecks and areas for optimization.
    • Document and standardize supply chain processes.
  • Inventory Management & Optimization:
    • Analyze inventory levels and implement strategies to optimize stock levels, minimize holding costs, and prevent stockouts.
    • Develop and maintain inventory control policies and procedures.
    • Utilize advanced Excel modeling to simulate inventory scenarios and assess impact of changes.

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • Knowledge of statistical modeling and forecasting techniques.
  • Experience in the manufacturing industry.
  • Experience with supply chain optimization tools.
  • Experience in the Indian manufacturing and logistics environment.

title: Engineering Manager, MAAS
description:
Join to apply for the Engineering Manager, MAAS role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include leading public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across sectors. We have a global, distributed team of over 1200 colleagues in more than 80 countries, with few office-based roles. Teams meet periodically in person at locations worldwide to align on strategy and execution.

We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to expand the MAAS team. Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide a top-tier solution for building and managing private bare-metal infrastructure, offering a cloud-style on-demand API for physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We seek engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership, with deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage, and data center networking.

MAAS components cover the entire software stack: from hardware detection and provisioning to the web interface, API, and CLI. Successful engineers are fluent across these layers and can anticipate the impacts of design choices in a complex distributed system.

At Canonical, you need a solid technical background, but your primary responsibility is to lead an effective team and develop your colleagues. You will help them grow, perform outstanding work, find personal and professional satisfaction, and collaborate effectively. Technical leadership and a background in software engineering are prerequisites. You will lead, challenge, and develop engineers, influence company culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work on strategy and execution. You will also collaborate with other engineering teams, such as cloud-init, LXD, and cloud services.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate leadership, deep Linux knowledge, and the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.

Location : This is a remote position available in EMEA or the Americas.

The role involves:

  1. Leading a distributed engineering team in your time zone
  2. Talent development through coaching, mentoring, and career planning
  3. Managing expectations with other teams, management, and stakeholders
  4. Promoting modern software development practices
  5. Participating in code and architecture reviews
  6. Engaging with broader teams, open source community, and partners
  7. Traveling for global events (4-6 weeks per year)

We seek candidates with:

  1. Strong academic background and a degree in a technical field
  2. Confidence in communication and feedback exchange
  3. A record of exceeding expectations
  4. Leadership and mentorship skills
  5. Passion for technology and personal projects
  6. Work ethic and confidence working with motivated colleagues
  7. Excellent English communication skills
  8. Experience with Linux (Debian/Ubuntu preferred)
  9. Interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, accountability
  10. Appreciation for diversity and multicultural work environments
  11. Self-motivation and thoughtfulness
  12. Result-oriented mindset and ability to meet commitments
  13. Willingness to travel internationally twice a year
  14. Understanding of modern Linux cloud technologies (networking, storage, containers, K8s)
  15. Programming experience in Python and Go
  16. Interest in developing and growing people

Nice-to-have skills include experience with Typescript and modern web frameworks.

Desenvolver planos de implementação para atender aos padrões do programa PSP 2.0, incluindo:

  • Conformidade com o PSM da OSHA (29 CFR 1910.119);
  • Regulamentações locais de PSM + LDC PSP 2.0 para a prevenção de acidentes graves (eventos de magnitude significativa, como incêndios, explosões, derramamentos que podem causar fatalidades, impactar a mídia ou a reputação da empresa).

Garantir que as informações de segurança do processo (P&IDs, normas técnicas) sejam mantidas atualizadas, bem como as PHAs e suas conexões lógicas com o restante dos elementos do PSM e a tecnologia necessária para garantir operações seguras.

Fornecer suporte direto aos locais de fabricação sobre questões operacionais, sistemas ambientais e melhores práticas para implementação.

Qualificações

  • Graduação em engenharia ou áreas afins, com pós-graduação em Segurança de Processos.
  • Familiaridade com estudos de análise de riscos de processos (PHA), técnicas de gerenciamento de projetos, revisões pré-embarque (PSSR), gerenciamento de mudanças (MOC) e gerenciamento de contratados.
  • Conhecimento de planejamento, atividades de design, engenharia de projetos, operações e manutenção. Fluência em inglês. Conhecimento em softwares de gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Experiência com instalações industriais com risco químico, gerenciamento de poeira em cereais, gás e petróleo ou riscos equivalentes, preferencialmente com foco na aplicação de um programa PSM.

Informações adicionais

Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Esta oportunidade também é destinada a pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

O valor sustentável está no centro do nosso propósito como empresa. Somos apaixonados por criar valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para os stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nossos colaboradores, parceiros comerciais, comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.

Job description

Durante nossa história, seguimos o DNALWSA de crescimento, inovação e governança. Nos últimos anos, muitas empresas chegaram para completar o ecossistema e nossa expertise cresceu, oferecendo mais possibilidades de conexões para atender grandes empresas e alguns de nossos produtos foram direcionados para solucionar questões mais complexas, foi aí que surgiu o segmentoWake , com o objetivo de pensar na jornada dos clientes, de uma maneira muito mais fluída e com integrações consistentes.

  • Coleta e Análise de Dados de Mercado:

  • Acompanhar as atividades dos concorrentes, incluindo novos produtos, estratégias de marketing, preços e posicionamento.

  • Ajudar na definição do posicionamento de produtos e mensagens-chave.
  • Desenvolvimento de Go-to-Market Strategies:
  • Contribuir para a criação de estratégias de entrada no mercado e lançamentos de novos produtos.
  • Trabalhar com equipes de vendas e marketing para garantir uma implementação eficaz das estratégias.
  • Mensuração e Relatórios de Desempenho:
  • Desenvolver métricas e KPIs para medir o desempenho de campanhas de marketing e iniciativas de produto.
  • Gerar relatórios periódicos de evolução de mercado endereçável

Requirements and skills

E para tirar de letra, você precisará:

Habilidades Analíticas:

  • Forte capacidade de análise de dados e uso de ferramentas analíticas (como Google Sheets, Quicksight, SQL, Tableau, etc).

title: Especialista de Planejamento de Demanda
description:
Resumo da Posição:

O Planejador de Demanda é responsável por desenvolver, manter e atualizar previsões de demanda para produtos, garantindo um planejamento preciso e colaborativo que suporte as necessidades comerciais, supply chain, compras e produção. O profissional atuará como o elo entre as áreas comerciais, marketing e operações, assegurando que a empresa tenha uma visão clara da demanda futura, minimizando rupturas e excesso de estoque, além de contribuir para a otimização da cadeia de suprimentos.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração, Logística, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em planejamento de demanda, supply chain ou áreas de planejamento e controle (MANDATORIO)
  • Conhecimento avançado de ferramentas de planejamento de demanda e sistemas ERP (ex: Plannera, SAP IBP, etc).
  • Experiência com modelos estatísticos e previsões quantitativas.
  • Habilidade em análise de dados e utilização de ferramentas como Excel (avançado), Power BI ou outras plataformas de Business Intelligence.
  • Experiência em participação em processos de S&OP.
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de colaborar com diversas áreas funcionais.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com alta atenção a detalhes e gerenciar múltiplas prioridades.
  • Habilidades analíticas, de resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico

Diferenciais (Desejável):

  • Experiência em empresas com operações complexas e multi-regionais.

Atividades

  • Desenvolver e atualizar previsões de demanda com base em análises estatísticas de dados históricos, sazonalidade, tendências de mercado e informações de clientes:
  • Obter e organizar dados históricos de vendas, variações sazonais e campanhas de marketing anteriores, garantindo que estejam completos e consistentes para análise.
  • Trabalhar com dados internos (histórico de vendas, promoções passadas) e externos (dados de mercado, tendências econômicas, clima, etc.)
  • Utilizar modelos estatísticos, como séries temporais (ARIMA, média móvel, suavização exponencial) e técnicas de regressão, para gerar previsões de demanda.
  • Avaliar e selecionar o modelo mais adequado para cada tipo de produto ou categoria, dependendo do comportamento da demanda.
  • Identificar padrões sazonais e cíclicos que possam influenciar a demanda, ajustando as previsões para diferentes períodos do ano. Adaptar as previsões conforme mudanças no mercado ou em condições econômicas.
  • Incorporar Tendências de Mercado: Analisar dados de tendências de mercado e comportamento de clientes
  • Utilizar informações qualitativas das equipes de vendas e marketing para ajustar previsões, incluindo aspectos como ciclos de vida de produtos.
  • Participar ativamente do processo de S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning), revisando e ajustando previsões com base em restrições de capacidade, metas financeiras e necessidades de mercado.
  • Monitorar o desempenho das previsões de demanda (acurácia de forecast) e implementar melhorias contínuas para aumentar a precisão.
  • Acompanhar KPIs relacionados à demanda, como forecast accuracy, nível de serviço, cobertura de estoque e giro de inventário, entre outros;
  • Comunicar os resultados e insights das previsões para stakeholders internos, ajudando na tomada de decisões estratégicas e operacionais.
  • Identificar e mitigar riscos de ruptura de estoque e sobrecarga de inventário, recomendando ações corretivas.
  • Utilizar ferramentas e softwares especializados de planejamento de demanda para realizar análises detalhadas e cenários “what-if” para otimização.
  • Desenvolver diferentes cenários de previsão para simular mudanças no mercado ou variáveis internas, como variações de preço, alterações no mix de produtos ou lançamentos de novas linhas, e avaliar o impacto dessas alterações na demanda projetada.
  • Manter a integridade e a atualização dos dados nos sistemas de planejamento, garantindo que todas as informações de demanda sejam precisas e atualizadas.
  • Propor e liderar iniciativas de melhoria contínua em processos de previsão e planejamento de demanda.

At Trustly, we’re on a mission to deliver a better way to pay and get paid. Consumers deserve a payment option that prioritizes financial responsibility, and merchants should have the independence to accept payments without unnecessary costs. This mission drives everything we do.

We’re revolutionizing the payments industry by making Pay by Bank the new standard at checkout, providing a smarter payment option to credit and debit cards. For merchants and consumers, this means the freedom to make and receive payments with greater security and ease.

Fueled by this purpose, we’ve grown into a global network connecting 9,000 merchants to 650 million consumers through 12,000 banks across 33 countries, processing over $58 billion annually. With regional offices in Vitória, Brazil and Silicon Valley, USA, and our global headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, we are a diverse team that spans over 30 nationalities. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².

Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.

No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.

A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.

Estamos desenvolvendo os negócios da no Brasil e precisamos aumentar nossa força de trabalho para atender à demanda do mercado. Essa pessoa irá auxiliar nas tarefas de vendas em regiões não cobertas por distribuidores. Ela será responsável por preparar cotações para os clientes com base nos leads, visitar clientes, desenvolver negócios e realizar follow-up. Também deverá buscar melhorias e desenvolver os processos do departamento para torná-lo mais eficiente e oferecer um melhor atendimento aos clientes. Será responsável por preparar e analisar a região em busca das melhores oportunidades para a Sany, atendendo aos requisitos dos clientes.

title: Sr. Regional Marketing Manager (LATAM)
description:
Neo4j is the leader in Graph Database & Analytics, helping organizations uncover hidden patterns and relationships across billions of data connections deeply, easily, and quickly. Customers use Neo4j to gain a deeper understanding of their business and reveal new ways of solving their most pressing problems. Over 84% of Fortune 100 companies use Neo4j, along with a vibrant community of 250,000+ developers, data scientists, and architects across the globe.

At Neo4j, we’re proud to build the technology that powers breakthrough solutions for our customers. These solutions have helped NASA get to Mars two years earlier, broke the Panama Papers for the ICIJ, and are helping Transport for London to cut congestion by 10% and save $750M a year. Some of our other notable customers include Intuit, Lockheed Martin, Novartis, UBS, and Walmart.

Neo4j experienced rapid growth this year as organizations looking to deploy generative AI (GenAI) recognized graph databases as essential for improving it’s accuracy, transparency, and explainability. Growth was further fueled by enterprise demand for Neo4j’s cloud offering and partnerships with leading cloud hyperscalers and ecosystem leaders. Learn more at neo4j.com and follow us on LinkedIn .

Our Vision:

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

JOB TITLE: Sr. Regional Marketing Manager (LATAM)

Location : Ideally based in or near São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil OR Miami, FL,. Travel will be required especially if based outside of São Paulo.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Role Overview As a key driver of revenue growth in our LATAM region, particularly in Brazil, you will play a pivotal role in achieving our ambitious revenue targets. We are seeking a strategic and results-oriented Senior Regional Marketing Manager (RMM) who can craft and execute high-impact marketing strategies and demand generation programs that align with regional pipeline and revenue objectives.

Reporting Structure The Senior RMM will be an integral member of our Americas Marketing team, reporting directly to the VP of Americas Marketing. This role requires building robust partnerships with the Neo4j LATAM sales team and collaborating effectively with various departments, including corporate marketing, digital, developer relations, communications (PR), and product marketing, to drive business success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Development : Formulate and execute the comprehensive marketing strategy for the LATAM region, incorporating digital marketing, partnerships, public relations (in collaboration with an agency and the communications team), account-based marketing (ABM), and event initiatives aimed at generating leads, opportunities, and deals.
  • Performance Accountability : Lead the execution and optimization of the marketing mix to meet key performance indicators, including Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) and Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs). Continuously evaluate and report on the effectiveness of marketing programs to enhance execution, efficiency, and overall results.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work collaboratively across all marketing functions to design and implement effective lead generation programs, encompassing digital initiatives, corporate events, and webinars.
  • Event Coordination : Define and implement LATAM-specific events and demand generation programs, including owned events, roadshows, workshops, and participation in third-party conferences. This includes audience segmentation, registration management, promotion, lead handling, and outcome tracking.
  • Channel Partnership : Cultivate and expand engagement with regional channel partners (GCP and AWS) through joint marketing initiatives.
  • Sales Development Partnership : Work closely with Sales Development teams to gather feedback, ensuring timely and effective follow-up on leads.
  • Strategic Communication : Effectively communicate marketing strategies, value propositions, positioning, and messaging to the LATAM sales team, ensuring they are equipped with the latest, most compelling content for effective sales cycles.
  • PR : Assist in facilitating customer and press participation in local activities, including press releases, case studies, event presentations, and industry awards.

Who You'll Work With

You’ll be a key member of the Americas Regional Marketing team. The team is responsible for driving the highest quality lead generation programs that take customers and prospects through their buyers’ journey using all activities in the marketing mix including digital, partner and event programs.

As a Senior Regional Marketer, you will drive opportunities and pipeline growth by developing and executing on a quarterly marketing plan based on approved budgets. You’ll recommend digital programs, specific regional activities and local events, and determine what demand generation content needs will drive business results for the region. This position requires significant cross-functional collaboration.

Who You Are

  • Languages : Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English is required for this role. While not required, proficiency in Spanish is considered a strong plus.
  • 7+ years in Regional Marketing, with a proven track record in developing and executing pipeline-generation programs, digital initiatives, and events. Experience with Account-Based Marketing (ABM) is a plus.
  • 5+ years collaborating on PR and thought leadership strategies for regional growth.
  • Strong demand generation expertise, analytical abilities, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proven experience in event planning, execution, and post-event analysis.
  • Exceptional communication and influencing skills, effective at all organizational levels.
  • Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively, partnering with internal teams and external vendors to meet goals.
  • Goal-oriented self-starter with a proactive, independent work style who thrives in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to lead projects from concept to completion.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to work at both the tactical and strategic levels, including effective budget management and ROI optimization.
  • Technical Proficiency : Advanced knowledge of Marketo, Tableau and Salesforce is essential.
Why Join Neo4j?

Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph database in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j.

  • Raised the biggest funding round in database history ($325M Series F). Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well-funded database companies in history.
  • Co-founder and CEO Emil Eifrem has built an amazing culture that prides itself on relationships, inclusiveness, innovation, and customer success.
  • Countless industry awards . Massive enterprises and individual developers/data scientists love Neo4j. A strong sense of community and ecosystem is built around the platform.
  • A recent Forrester Total Economic Impact Study cited Neo4j as delivering 417% ROI to customers.
  • Neo4j was named as a Visionary in the 2023 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud Database Management Systems among 19 other recognized global DBMS vendors. Neo4j was also ranked as a Strong Performer among 14 top vendors in The Forrester Wave: Vector Databases, Q3 2024.

WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is searching for a Lead Gameplay Technical Animator with a passion for expressive character movement to join our team. In this talented team of veteran and emerging artists, you’ll collaborate across teams and contribute directly to Fortnite and other Epic projects. Joining this team means you’re motivated to seek solutions to problems and work with other disciplines to make positive changes to workflows, tools, and technologies that directly impact Gameplay.

In this role, you will

  • Work closely with technical animators, Leads, Directors, and Outsource Managers on the team to ensure assets are set up for success in the different stages of production
  • Communicate and drive alignment around strategy for technical animation and adjacent gameplay teams
  • Work with production to schedule, prioritize, and delegate assets for the team
  • Working closely with animators, modelers, and designers to ensure a smooth development pipeline that delivers high-quality assets. This will also include mentorship of rigging-focused technical animators
  • Assisting with pipeline tools and working with engine and project leads on the continuous improvement of those engine tools
  • Setting up assets in Unreal Engine 5; including control rigs, cloth, physics, and blueprints
  • Rigging characters, weapons, creatures, and vehicles. Maintain detailed documentation, video reference, and examples of art asset production, procedures, and engine requirements to support internal and external artists

What we're looking for

  • Extensive experience rigging characters in Maya and/or Unreal Engine
  • A portfolio demonstrating rigging for a range of characters, bipeds, and creatures, both body and faces
  • Attention to aesthetic detail, especially with regard to character deformation and physics movement
  • Familiarity with the Unreal Engine 5 art pipeline
  • A positive individual with strong written communication and teamwork skills
  • Exceptional problem-solver
  • Control Rig experience a plus
  • Python programming is a plus

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

Our intent is to cover all things that are medically necessary and improve the quality of life. We pay 100% of the premiums for both you and your dependents. Our coverage includes Medical, Dental, a Vision HRA, Long Term Disability, Life Insurance & a 401k with competitive match. We also offer a robust mental well-being program through Modern Health, which provides free therapy and coaching for employees & dependents. Throughout the year we celebrate our employees with events and company-wide paid breaks. We offer unlimited PTO and sick time and recognize individuals for 7 years of employment with a paid sabbatical.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

title: Component Leader(d/f/m)
description:
We are seeking an Elevator Architect to join our R&D team and assist us in creating a standard global elevator product architecture, which includes the functional definition of modules and module interfaces.

You will be a member of the Global Product Architecture Team, which comprises system architecture methodology experts who coordinate and drive the creation of deliverables for the Modular Product Architecture Project.

You will collaborate closely with key stakeholders from R&D, PLM, PSM, MFG, and Field/Sales, as well as experts in all product areas, to standardize key module interfaces to minimize rework when module implementation changes.

You will also participate in the Product Architecture Update Process, which establishes the methodology and standard work for updating the architecture and standard interfaces.

This activity is a high priority for our company, as it will enable R&D efficiency and cost reduction for all elevator products.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Lead Platform Development: Lead the development and maintenance of core platform components, including kernel modules, device drivers, board support packages (BSPs), and hardware abstraction layers, ensuring seamless integration with hardware and higher-level software layers.
  2. System Image Customization: Lead the creation of Linux-based system images using the Yocto Project, tailoring configurations to meet specific hardware and project requirements.
  3. Platform Tooling and Abstraction Layers: Build and maintain tools, APIs, and abstraction layers that simplify application development. Provide a reliable and efficient platform that enables application teams to focus on delivering innovative solutions.
  4. Team Leadership and Mentorship: Lead and mentor a team of developers focused on platform development. Cultivate technical growth within the team by sharing expertise in embedded software development. Promote a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability to achieve high-quality deliverables.
  5. Planning and Transparency: Track team progress and ensure alignment with project timelines and deliverables. Maintain clear visibility into development activities, identify risks early, and adjust plans as needed to meet committed deadlines. Report progress and challenges to stakeholders to ensure transparency and accountability.
  6. Collaboration and Team Work: Work closely with the Technical Leader, Product Owner, other Component Leaders and stakeholders to align platform development with broader project goals. Collaborate with hardware engineers, platform, application and test automation teams to ensure seamless integration and optimal performance across the solution.

Qualifications:

  1. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  2. Experience: 7+ years of experience in embedded systems development, with a focus on low-level programming and Linux-based platforms.
  3. Skills:
    • Strong knowledge of embedded Linux systems, kernel programming, and hardware-software integration.
    • Experience with the Yocto Project for system image building and customization.
    • Proficiency in developing device drivers, BSPs, and hardware abstraction layers.
    • Familiarity with hardware and networking communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet, TCP/IP, GSM.
    • Strong experience with troubleshooting of complex problems in diverse environments.
    • Basic knowledge for reading electronic schematics and datasheets.
    • Familiarity with end-to-end testing approaches and test automation, preferably with hardware-in-the-loop testing, to ensure reliable integration and quality of embedded systems.
    • Experience with Agile methodologies, backlog prioritization, and tools like JIRA and Confluence.
  4. Soft Skills:
    • Strong ability to interact and align with stakeholders and technical leaders across the company, ensuring effective communication and shared understanding of project goals.
    • Proven ability to contribute to a collaborative team environment, always working as a team player and actively supporting colleagues and driving collective success.
    • Highly collaborative with excellent organizational and interpersonal skills.
    • Clear and effective communicator, able to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
    • Ability to work in a fast-paced, global environment, managing multiple priorities and adjusting to shifting requirements.
  5. Language: Proficient English communication skills, both written and spoken.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Experience with hardware development.
  2. Experience working in a global environment with cross-functional teams.
  3. Background in digital transformation, connectivity solutions, or IoT in the industrial or building automation sector.

Amazon is looking for a Senior Program Manager to drive carbon reduction in our Brazil transportation operations including through adoption of Low Carbon Fuels and Electrification, as part of our Rest of World (ex North America, Europe) Operations Sustainability team.   4. Engage in public-private partnerships and industry coalitions to unlock innovative solutions. Partner with Public Policy teams to identify key policy opportunities to accelerate zero/low-carbon fuels and transportation technology adoption.
  5. Drive broad engagement among leaders and Amazon colleagues at all levels to influence decision-making and daily behaviors toward sustainability goals.

  • Working experience of program or project management.

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Neste contexto, a AVSI mobiliza, operacionaliza e gerencia os Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL Distribuição em São Paulo, implementando iniciativas de eficiência energética, reciclagem e engajamento comunitário em comunidades de baixa renda. Os programas são estruturados em quatro diretrizes: Relacionamento com a comunidade; Desenvolvimento local; Educação para o consumo consciente de energia; e Iniciativa de trocar resíduos recicláveis por descontos na conta de energia.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O Articulador Social atuará na linha de frente do projeto Rede Liderança, Oficinas e Palestras comunitárias na área de concessão da Enel SP. A função interage diretamente com os parceiros envolvidos (Associações de moradores, representantes de bairro, ONGs, grupos produtivos comunitários, instituições religiosas, universidades, instituições públicas e privadas), organizando e realizando os eventos.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO:

  1. Preparação e condução das reuniões de liderança com metodologia de mediação de grupos e dinâmicas;
  2. Organização e realização de Oficinas para mulheres e Palestras comunitárias;
  3. Manter um canal de comunicação próximo e direto com os parceiros, possibilitando a melhoria da qualidade dos serviços prestados pela Enel, minimizando conflitos e gerando valor compartilhado;
  4. Criar e propor estratégias de abordagem com os grupos;
  5. Realizar visitas institucionais para identificação das lideranças comunitárias;
  6. Proceder com o mapeamento e análise dos perfis das lideranças comunitárias;
  7. Prospectar líderes comunitários para fins de aplicação de questionários;
  8. Analisar e mapear os resultados e objetivos alcançados;
  9. Identificar temas levantados pelos participantes dos grupos e propor as temáticas das reuniões;
  10. Enviar relatórios periódicos de desempenho das ações do projeto;
  11. Prospectar possíveis grupos produtivos de interesse da ENEL;
  12. Participar de momentos formativos e de trabalhos propostos pela Organização;
  13. Cumprir suas atribuições conforme descrição do cargo, Código de Ética e Conduta da AVSI Brasil, e Procedimentos Operacionais Internos;
  14. Realizar outras atividades correlatas, conforme necessidade do setor.
